squircle.comment: Elliptical corner mask (SVG rect rx/ry) matches the bezel SVG's measured arc. Canvas alpha scan of iphone-17-pro-bezel.svg (1350×2760 canvas) shows the corner arc extends ~210px horizontally and ~200px vertically from the rim inset. Image occupies 89.17%w × 94.96%h of frame, so in image-pixel terms: rx = 210/(1350×0.8917) = 17.4% of image width; ry = 200/(2760×0.9496) = 7.63% of image height. Both expressed as % of WIDTH (consistent normalization): ry_of_width = 7.63% × (image_h/image_w) = 7.63% × 2.178 = 16.6%. Rounded-rect/elliptical corner (not Apple squircle) because the bezel itself is drawn with simple cubic beziers approximating an ellipse — the mask matches the bezel, not the physical device.
